levels.surface: أبوالحسن محمد بن أحمد بن علي ابن أسد الاسدي

notes: «1-99» is a report number and «رضي الله عنه» a formula; both are left out.
The first «أبي» is the compiler's own father, a bare relation with no name written; the second «أبي» is the father of جعفر بن سنيد, also a bare relation.
The Prophet is the end of the chain; the saying's Companion Jabir is the last link.

fixes.reason: RWY keeps the verb and the blessing of the first link («حدثنا أبي رضي الله عنه قال») as one name; the text's name is only أبي.

evidence.quote: حدثنا أبي رضي الله عنه قال
